purpose: Shows the Type line of a Plan card: one GilbVeda type chosen with the type chooser, shown as a chip that opens the type's definition, stored as the term address ("No GilbVeda type" stores `none`), with a question before an earlier concept is replaced.
namedChanges: `GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN` (from `src/lib/base/stakeholderKinds.ts`) is `termOrigin()` from `term-origin`, in `termUrlOf` (line 32): `` `${termOrigin()}/base/t/${typeName}` ``. The export is kept.

`ShellContext.openOntologyConcept` is the new optional prop `onOpenOntology?: (typeName: string) => void`. The source read `shell` at line 51 (`useContext(ShellContext)`) and passed `(n) => shell?.openOntologyConcept?.(n)` at three call sites: the picture button (line 90), the chip popover (line 101) and the arrow popover (line 118). Each now receives `onOpenOntology` as it is. (A difference: the source always passed a function, so every popover had an "Open in Ontology" button; now it has one only when the prop is given.)

The props `search`, `blankReach` and `renderTypeIcon` are new, and are passed to the `TypeChooser` (line 155) as `search={search} blankReach={blankReach} renderTypeIcon={renderTypeIcon}`: in the source the chooser got its search, reach and icons from its defaults. `search` and `blankReach` are required.

library.title: Type field of a Plan card
library.note: One GilbVeda type as a chip with the Replace question; the first line Type · Level · Version is plan-type-level-version. Plan.Type
